insert into `couple` (id,`code`,`status`,report_time,create_time,update_time) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.code}, #{item.status},#{item.reportTime},#{item.createTime},#{item.updateTime})
on duplicate key update `status` = values(status), report_time = values(report_time), update_time = values(update_time)
